newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Petron, Shell market shares up in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Petron, Shell market shares up in 1996.

text.p: Market shares of Philippine refiners Petron Corp and Pilipinas Shell Petroleum Corp (PSPC) rose in 1996 while Caltex (Philippines) Inc posted a decline.
Based on oil trade data announced on Friday, Petron's market share was 41.3 percent for all of 1996 from 40.9 percent the previous year. The data is prepared by the country's three oil refiners.
PSPC, a unit of Royal Dutch/Shell, improved in 1996 to 33.7 percent from 32.2 percent in 1995.
The market share of Caltex Philippines Inc, a unit of Caltex Petroleum Corp, dropped to 24.8 percent last year from 26.9 in 1995. Caltex Petroleum is a joint venture of Texaco Inc and Chevron Corp.
A total of 128.706 million barrels were sold in the domestic market in 1996 from the year-ago level of 122.8 million barrels.
